literal_meaning: ইন্দ্রের লুপ্তি (Indra's disappearance or loss, figuratively referring to hair loss)
figurative_meaning_en: completely bald or head full of bald spots
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মাথা সম্পূর্ণ ইন্দ্রলুপ্ত হয়ে গেছে।
বয়স বাড়ার সাথে সাথে তার ইন্দ্রলুপ্ত অবস্থা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His head has become completely Indralupta.
With age, he has turned bald as described by Indralupta.
history: The idiom draws from Hindu mythology where Indra, the king of gods, is sometimes associated with concepts of loss or eclipse, metaphorically extended to baldness in Bengali folklore.
note: This idiom is obscure and primarily used in literary or descriptive contexts to denote total baldness.
